bio:
I'm Kadir Lofca. I worked on products with 2M+ users, won an IEEE award, and now building an interactive experiences lab. 

My work is an extension of my life philosophy — shape your environment, shape yourself. I'm deliberate about what I surround myself with: the space I work in, the habits I build, the people I spend time with. The result compounds. 

I cook hearty meals, boulder, play tennis (and table tennis), and work out. I also travel to see unique architecture. 

P.S. I'll always make time for a good conversation!
